that still contains the trace. Ring-level core: if V(g) cap V(h) = empty in a commutative ring then

partition of unity. Base shrinking is licensed throughout by the pointwise gate
isLocallyCertified_of_forall_prime_exists_certified_adaptation.

after localizing) divisor scheme is trivial after a Zariski shrink of the base, which is exactly the
freedom the pointwise gate provides.
